profile_text.body:
Zhejiang University is a non-profit university lab headquartered in Hangzhou, China. Its English website currently presents an announcement for a lecture by Yongzhong Sun, to be held in Room 101, Haina Building 2, Zijingang Campus. The abstract describes a talk on the stability of viscous incompressible fluids driven by buoyancy, using the Boussinesq equations as a mathematical model, and introduces a class of stationary fluid states with a strictly increasing background temperature.

The available material does not describe any AI products from the university. No litigation, SEC filings, or patent records are associated with the organization in the provided information.
